citations.claim: first violating step cart outside track x=2.402 >2.4
approaching limit, cart still inside but close

counterfactual.change: changed initial.v from 0.448 to 0.0, keeping all else same; cart stays near origin and no track violation occurs, proving initial velocity drift is causal

explanation: Controller stabilizes pole (theta ~0.08 rad, margin ~0.71) but allows cart position to integrate uncontrolled. With initial v=0.448 m/s and x=0, no pushes, sensor_noise 0, controller force stays <1 N (0.82 N at violation) far below force_limit 66.4. Cart x grows monotonically: 1.22 at step 400, 2.03 at step 500, 2.402 at step 533 exceeding +/-2.4. Counterfactual setting v=0 eliminates violation, proving cause is lack of cart position regulation.

violation.detail: cart at x=2.403 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The cart drifts steadily to the far right end of the track from step 530 to 533 while the pole stays balanced upright. At step 533 the cart reaches the track limit and exceeds the allowed |x| <= 2.4 m boundary.
